about_the_game:
《CIVIREVIVAL》

A Story-Driven Space Epic

As Earth falls into ruin, the last survivors set sail aboard the Ark, carrying the final spark of humanity into the endless cosmos. New worlds await your claim. New civilizations await your vision.

Among the starlight, you are the pioneer, the conqueror, and the architect of humanity's future.

Rebuild Civilization: From a Single Ship to a Galactic Empire

From a Single Ship: With Earth lost to catastrophe, the Ark carries humanity's last survivors adrift in the cosmos. You must lead them to rekindle the flame of civilization on a new world.

Build Your Empire: From your first outpost, expand your territory. Strategically plan your planetary development, balancing industry, agriculture, science, and the welfare of your people to lay the foundation of a star-spanning empire.

Defend Against Cosmic Threats: The dark void hides untold dangers. Assemble your fleet and crush your enemies in real-time tactical combat, relying on both strategy and firepower.

Navigate Critical Choices: Sudden crises and branching narratives will constantly test your judgment. Will you risk it all for a great opportunity, or play it safe to secure your stability? Your choices will shape your destiny.

Encounter the Unknown: Secrets of a Vast Galaxy

Unearth Cosmic Relics: Ancient ruins, Gaia worlds, mysterious nebulae, and stellar phenomena await. Every expedition could reveal a new truth or birth a new threat.

Meet Alien Civilizations: Humanity is not alone. Diverse alien species may become your allies or obstacles to your expansion. Diplomacy, trade, or war—your choices will write your epic.

Uncover the Ultimate Truth: Through exploration and research, piece together the hidden history of this galaxy. Collect forbidden artifacts, decipher lost technologies, and expose the cold, hard secrets of the cosmos.

Confront Galactic Calamities: Every disaster is both a catastrophe and an opportunity. Tame their power, and they may become the catalyst for your civilization's ascension.

Choose Your Future: Your Civilization, Your Epic

War and Peace: Will you forge order from the chaos of war, or unite allies to stand against cosmic horrors?

Define Your Creed: Politics, ideology, faith, technology—you define your civilization's path. Will it become a beacon of hope for the galaxy, or a tyrannical empire that consumes all?

Forge Your Legend with Heroes: Over a dozen unique heroes will join your journey, each with their own backstory and abilities. Fight alongside them, or part ways based on your decisions, as you write your own interstellar saga.

This is a space epic of choice and destiny.

Will you rebuild order with fire and steel, or join hands with allies to fight back the darkness?

Will you forge a beacon for the stars, or lead humanity back into the abyss?

The future is in your hands.

short_description: Lead humanity's last Ark and rebuild civilization in a cosmos dominated by ancient powers. Start from nothing, build your fleet, and develop new technology. Forge alliances or wage war to survive—humanity's future is in your hands.
